title: Ukrainian — passport practice 2007–2010
authority: Attributed to Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 858 of 26.06.2007 (technical description of passport forms)
description: Russian-style passport transliteration reported for Ukrainian passports issued 2007–2010: Г→G, Є→IE, Ї→I, Й→I, Ю→IU, Я→IA in every position, И→Y; Ь and apostrophe omitted.
notes: Low-confidence source: the table comes from the 'Passport 2007' column of Wikipedia's Romanization of Ukrainian, which is tagged 'failed verification' (the cited resolution contains no transliteration table). The interscript project's ua-ukr-2007 map instead reproduces the KMU 2010 behaviour.

Samples are computed from the table, not official examples. Spellings of this type (Sergii, Ievgen, Iuliia, Galyna) are attested in documents of the period; use the scheme for matching older passports rather than for producing new spellings.
